programme.desc: Prati kriminalnu psihologinju Bárbáru i njenju porodicu nakon što postane žrtva jednog od najnovijih, viralno širenih oblika nasilnog zločina, brzih otmica.

programme.title: Stanje uma
programme.desc: Očajnički tražeći novi početak, njujorški detektiv Dejvid Seka i njegova trudna supruga beže od mučnog života u Njujorku i vraćaju se u rodni Nju Džersi, gde on nevoljno prihvata posao u lokalnoj policijskoj stanici. Njegovi prioriteti iznenada se menjaju kada naiđe na tajanstveni osmomilimetarski film, slučajno otkriven u starinskoj kutiji za nakit. Stvari se usijavaju kada shvati da je pronašao ključni dokaz koji raskrinkava pozadinu ubistva predsednika Kenedija.

programme.title: Zdravo za gotovo
programme.desc: Dva stara prijatelja iz policijske škole ponovo se susreću nakon što su im se putevi potpuno razišli. Onaj koji je s druge strane zakona uvlači onog ispravnog u svoj raskošni život, koji je nasledio od nedavno ubijenog prijatelja.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Njuškalo i ukleti dvorac
programme.desc: Njuškala, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture. Tokom letnjeg raspusta Tom ostaje s Mirjam i Njuškalom kod svog čika Hansa i bratanca Jaapa. Čuli su za ukleti dvorac u susedstvu. Legenda o ovom dvorcu kaže da se u srednjem veku izvesni vitez Betram zaljubio u sluškinju Ejdu, ali je ona već bila zaljubljena u konjušara. Betram rešava da se na užasan način osveti ovo dvoje i od tada se priča da je šuma oko dvorca ukleta. Na putu kroz šumu do dvorca, Tom, Mirjam i Njuškalo prate bandu krijumčara. To ih ponovo vodi u uzbudljivu avanturu…

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Skoro prijatelji
programme.desc: Čarli, neambiciozni muškarac u srednjim dvadesetim godinama koji i dalje živi s majkom i očuhom i zaljubljuje se u mladu ženu koja je u vezi s ozbiljnim muškarcem.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše.

programme.title: Šta sve radimo za ljubav
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Nestala
programme.desc: Kad njena sestra nestane, Džil je ubeđena da se vratio serijski ubica koji ju je kidnapovao pre dve godine. Spremna je da se još jednom suoči s čovekom koji ju je oteo.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Se-jon pronalazi Sang-hunov dnevnik i počinje da sumnja u njegov identitet. Jung-von parališe snimak afere s Min-gjuom. Istražujući Min-džejevu smrt, Eun-su nailazi na tragove drugih žena. Hva-jong tokom tajnog susreta s Te-oom saznaje razornu istinu.

programme.title: Pisac iz senke
programme.desc: Pisac iz senke angažovan je da dovrši memoare bivšeg britanskog premijera, ali slučajno otkriva tajne koje bi mogle da mu ugroze život.

programme.title: Pisac iz senke
programme.desc: Pisac iz senke angažovan je da dovrši memoare bivšeg britanskog premijera, ali slučajno otkriva tajne koje bi mogle da mu ugroze život.

programme.title: Majčino svedočenje
programme.desc: Najcrnje slutnje majke bivšeg robijaša obistinjuju se kada shvati da joj je sin upleten u ubistvo.

programme.title: Utvrđivanje smrti
programme.desc: Kako bi pobegao od ogromnih kockarskih dugova, veoma odbojni Ris Vilijams odlučuje da inscenira sopstvenu smrt uz pomoć dugogodišnje sapatnice, supruge Kejti. Kada Ris "umre", Kejti nasleđuje pet miliona dolara od polise osiguranja, što će im pomoći da otplate dugove i započnu novi život na nekom drugom mestu. Ali, da li je moguće da prevara krene po zlu, a Ris završi zaista mrtav? Risova svastika, Džini, mogla bi da obezbedi validne informacije agentima osiguranja, Loganu i Meku, od kojih je jedan zaljubljen u Kejti.

programme.title: U kandžama lopova
programme.desc: Kada Džejk, čuvar obezbeđenja u malom hotelu, nenamerno pomogne prelepoj pljačkašici, postaje glavni osumnjičeni i odmah ga otpuštaju. Džejk odlučuje da sam prati pljačkašicu i povrati ukradenu imovinu.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Njuškalo i ledena ptica
programme.desc: Njuškalo, nemačkog ovčara, odgajio je Tom. On je psa naučio mnogim posebnim veštinama i sa svojom devojkom Mirjam upada u uzbudljive avanture.U ovoj avanturi, Tom i njegovi prijatelji Njuškalo i Mirjam idu na jedrenje tokom letnjeg raspusta. Usput na vašaru sreću strašnu braću Džimija i Nilsa, kao i njihovog psa Lebasa. Tako počinje još jedna šerlokholmsovska avantura…

programme.title: Julije Cezar
programme.desc: Epohalan prikaz Julija Cezara, posljednjeg diktatora Rima, čija smrt je također označila kraj Rimske Republike. Priča o njegovim kampanjama u Galiji i Egiptu, njegovoj rivalstvu s generalom Pompejem i konačnom atentatu pod rukama Bruta i Kasija.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: Tomiris, kraljica Amazonki, povela je 600 godina pre nove ere krvavi rat protiv Persijskog carstva. Kada persijski kralj Kir uništi njeno selo, ona okuplja ogromnu vojsku da oslobodi svoj narod. Slede spektakularne bitke, borbe na život i smrt i spletke surovog kralja koji silom i prevarama želi da pokori narod.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se da održi svoju poslastičarnicu, ali jednog dana izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora primorava je da zatvori posao. Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom
programme.desc: Tokom krstarenja Karibima, Dženi ostaje nasukana na obali sa svojim rokenrol idolom. Očarana idejom da će neko vreme provesti nasamo s njim, uspeva da sakrije činjenicu da se nalaze na samo nekoliko koraka od svog odmarališta.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Paigeina majka želi da kći krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, no Paige želi biti spisateljica. Kada Joan odluči prodati izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Paige to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži posljednju šansu — ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da nitko, pa ni Daniel, posljednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena obitelj predstavlja prijetnju.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Senka koja proganja žene konačno dobija oblik. Shvativši ko je Sang-hun, Se-jon skriva mržnju i prati tragove do muža. Eun-su se približava Min-džejevom ubici i traži ukradeni snimak, dok Jung-von otkriva ko joj je poslao ucenu.

programme.title: Ti si na potezu
programme.desc: Uspešan njujorški biznismen je na video-pozivu sa suprugom i detetom, koji su u poseti njenoj porodici u Meksiku, kada iznenada postaje svedok brutalnog napada na njih i otmice. Pošto se ne može osloniti na to da će državni organi sprovesti zakon, on kreće da pronađe svoju porodicu i osveti se za nasilje koje je nad njima počinjeno.

programme.title: Mlada srca
programme.desc: Harper polazi u srednju školu i započinje vezu s Tilijem, najboljim prijateljem svog brata. Dok se ona suočava s osudom okoline, stariji Tili dobija čestitke, čime počinje sasvim savremena ljubavna priča u doba pokreta "Time's Up" i "Me Too".

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: Due to a possible cholera epidemic onboard, passengers on a ship are forced to disembark at Pago Pago, a small village on a Pacific island where it incessantly rains. Among the stranded passengers are Sadie Thompson, a prostitute, and Alfred Davidson, a fanatic missionary who will try to redeem her.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

programme.title: Please Murder Me
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: The Inspector General
programme.desc: An illiterate stooge in a traveling medicine show wanders into a strange town and is picked up on a vagrancy charge. The town's corrupt officials mistake him for the inspector general whom they think is traveling in disguise. Fearing he will discover they've been pocketing tax money, they make several bungled attempts to kill him.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Our Daily Bread
programme.desc: John and Mary Sims are city-dwellers hit hard by the financial fist of The Depression. Driven by bravery (and sheer desperation) they flee to the country and, with the help of other workers, set up a farming community _ a socialist mini-society. The newborn community suffers many hardships _ drought, vicious raccoons and the long arm of the law _ but ultimately pull together to reach a bread-based Utopia.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: The Tall T
programme.desc: An independent former ranch foreman is kidnapped along with an heiress, who is being held for ransom by trio of ruthless outlaws.

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: The Jungle Woman
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: Dead Men Walk
programme.desc: The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.

programme.title: Fear and Desire
programme.desc: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

programme.title: Fear and Desire
programme.desc: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Girl Gang
programme.desc: A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.

programme.title: Bella Vista
programme.desc: A film about place and belonging.

programme.title: The North Star
programme.desc: A Ukrainian village must suddenly contend with the German invasion of June 1941.

programme.title: Club Paradise
programme.desc: A naive young girl, looking to escape from a bad family situation, falls in love with a man who turns out to be a cad, and leads her down the road to ruin.

programme.title: Sunny
programme.desc: The beautiful Anna Neagle stars as a circus performer who falls in love with a rich car dealer's son, against her family's wishes. Features some spirited dance numbers with Ray Bolger.

programme.title: The Woman in Green
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes investigates when young women around London turn up murdered, each with a finger severed. Scotland Yard suspects a madman, but Holmes believes the killings to be part of a diabolical plot.

programme.title: Omsch
programme.desc: A travelling artist, painter and filmmaker has a centenarian neighbour. The relationship between this man in his forties and the solitary old lady with a wicked sense of humour gradually becomes a kind of elective kinship. Their discussions, interrupted and picked up again over the years, form the fabric of this personal, tender and surprising film.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: Nancy Drew... Reporter
programme.desc: While participating in a contest at a local newspaper in which school children are asked to submit a news story, local attorney Carson Drew's daughter Nancy intercepts a real story assignment. She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: The Pilgrim
programme.desc: Disguised as a priest, an escaped convict makes his way to Texas. He ends up in a small rural town where the townsfolk mistake him for their new church minister.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Answer Me
programme.desc: The love story of a couple which, after the marriage and the birth of the first son, turns into hell. Taken from the novel Rispondimi by Susanna Tamaro.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Peril
programme.desc: Drummond's wedding with Phyllis is interrupted when the inspector guarding their gifts is killed. He tries to trace the killers and uncovers the mystery of diamond counterfeiters.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Nutsa lives with her two small children in suburb of Tblissi, Georgia. With her Goga, they would bee today a regular family if he hadn't been arrested. Between the wedding in prison and the monthly visits, a routine sets in. Wil they be able to overcome this double reality?

programme.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
programme.desc: A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

programme.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
programme.desc: A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

programme.title: Autumn Has Already Started
programme.desc: A single mother from the country raising a 6th grade boy comes to Tokyo, leaves the boy to live with his uncle's family, runs a struggling grocery store, and works a local inn. The boy befriends a girl, the daughter of the innkeeper.

programme.title: Silver on the Sage
programme.desc: Hoppy goes undercover as a gambler from the East when Bar 20 cattle are stolen by unknown rustlers. Brennan/Talbot are twin brothers (one a casino owner, the other a rancher) and Hoppy believes they provide alibis for each other while one is out committing crimes. Hoppy gets a job in the casino to learn more but is exposed when a gambling gunslinger notices him.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: Cora, a 19-year-old girl, has recently returned to the place where she spent her childhood, Bucco. The arrival of the mysterious Saverio gradually upsets the harmony of the "holy" place, unearthing a crime committed by the villagers 40 years before.

programme.title: The Man of the Eiffel Tower
programme.desc: French police inspector Maigret investigates the murder of a rich Paris widow and ends up chasing the killer up the Eiffel Tower's girders.

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.

programme.title: Smash-up, the Story of a Woman
programme.desc: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.

programme.title: Arima
programme.desc: ARIMA It is the story of four women and a girl who- se existence is disrupted by the sudden arrival of two strangers. One of them is fleeing from the other, sneaking around town like an elusive being, a ghostly presence of uncertain existence. The other character --an injured man carrying a gun-- will disrupt the women's way of life in different ways. The whole plot takes place on the fine line between reality and imagination, between dreams and nightmares, fear and desire, within a story shrouded in mystery ARIMA is something you glimpse through the mist, something you can sense but still fail to see clearly. A dream, a memory, a desire.

programme.title: Badge of Honor
programme.desc: Bob Gordon comes from a rich background but wants make it on his own. He dreams of becoming a newspaper reporter and he eventually gets his chance.

programme.title: My Dear Secretary
programme.desc: A budding young writer thinks it's her lucky day when she is chosen to be the new secretary for Owen Waterbury, famous novelist. She is soon disppointed, however, when he turns out to be an erratic, immature playboy. programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Travel Thru History

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city's growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum. We then travel to the nearby Sao Tome Basilica, the church and burial site of St. Thomas the Apostle. In Pondicherry, French influences can still be felt in the tree-lined streets, colonial mansions and cafés. Its beautiful setting on the Bay of Bengal makes Pondicherry a delightful place to spend the day. We also visit the ancient port city of Mahabalipuram, where the landscape is dominated by carved-stone architecture. The final highlight of our tour is the Descent of Ganga, which is the world's largest bas-relief carving.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This ancient ruined city, lost to history, was one of the most powerful in the world during its prime. The architectural sophistication and sheer size will amaze. Then Journeys heads out to the deep ocean for some big game fishing. Will we land the big one or return empty handed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial "swords into ploughshares" Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system. Ironically it's one of the few exploits Mankind undertakes that doesn't occur in nature.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories

Now, bioplastics grown in microorganisms—and possibly plants—offer quirky, sustainable alternatives for the future.

programme.desc: In this episode, we face the wild winds—hurricanes, cyclones, tornadoes, twisters, and typhoons. These powerful storms differ in form: hurricanes grow over warm oceans and can span 600 miles, while tornadoes are spinning air tubes touching ground and clouds, reaching speeds of 200 mph. They can destroy buildings, uproot trees, and hurl vehicles like toys. A tornado's path may stretch over a mile wide and 50 miles long. The U.S. sees about 1,000 tornadoes yearly—2% violent enough to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow. In the old city, we travel by rickshaw through the narrow streets and discover a world that is quickly disappearing. Then it's on to the tomb of Humayun, whose architectural design inspired one of the Seven Wonders of the World, the great Taj Mahal. We visit 2 mosques that are in the record books: the very first mosque in Delhi and the largest mosque in India. Next we visit the National Gandhi Museum where we view personal items from Gandhi's life, visit a temple that's open to all faiths and complete the quickest tour of India, without leaving Delhi.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the greatest ancient monuments in the world are in South India—Hampi and Konark. These two wonders of the world were lost to the west, but now are at the top of many bucket lists. Join Bill as he takes the veil off these two incredible achievements of man.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Featured in films and documentaries, the mane-less lions of Tsavo have a fierce reputation _ man-eaters. Journeys embarks on a photo hunt for these legendary beasts of the bush. In the process, we witness the raw power of the ghosts in the dark.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Once a year in good rain years, the deserts of South Africa explode in color. This is the greatest flower bloom in the world. We venture into the desert to experience this first-hand and film the rare animals that call this arid land home.

As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Freedom, the Legend Of the Eagles
programme.desc: This film is a visual thrill, a dream come true of men flying alongside the last Wild Eagle living in the Alps. It is the story of an unlikely encounter between Roï the last Sea Eagle in the wild in the French Alps and Kaaba a bird of the same species, but one that has been captive for years. With the help of one man who is going to change her destiny we witness Kaaba as she undergoes an astonishing learning process on the way to Freedom

programme.title: The Boy From the Wild
programme.desc: Growing up on a Game Reserve meant to help wildlife get out of captivity, it shares how it began & how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments in the wild.

programme.title: Andalusia: The Moorish Architecture
programme.desc: Andalusia, the Spanish territory has a confluence of cultures which is represented in its architecture! Visigothic, Roman, Byzantine and Arab _ the structures in the region display all these influences. Between 8th & 15th century, several dynasties from Arab to Berber conquered Andalusia impacting the way of life of people. The film tells this story through beautiful edifices of Andalusia.

programme.title: Life in the Blue
programme.desc: This film uncovers the rich diversity of life in the open ocean, where survival happens in a 10-meter band beneath the surface. Contrary to popular belief, these vast blue waters teem with species—from barracuda spiraling in defense to blue sharks crossing 4,000 km of Atlantic waters. Dolphins hunt schools of fish, while turtles, pilot whales, and whale sharks undertake epic migrations. Even shipwrecks become vibrant oases, colonized by corals and fish. In this harsh, shelterless world, only the most adaptable survive.

programme.title: Crazy About Your Pets
programme.desc: This documentary explores with tons of humor the strange and captivating bond between a person and its animal pet. We'll follow 4 owners that have chosen a very special animal to keep them company, a pet quite out of the common. Your audiences will have the best time following the daily lives of these characters and there amazing pets: An athletic dog, a pounds pig, a cobra and even a Crocodile!

programme.title: Crazy About Your Pets
programme.desc: This documentary explores with tons of humor the strange and captivating bond between a person and its animal pet. We'll follow 4 owners that have chosen a very special animal to keep them company, a pet quite out of the common. Your audiences will have the best time following the daily lives of these characters and there amazing pets: An athletic dog, a pounds pig, a cobra and even a Crocodile!

programme.title: Nickel, the Kanak's Treasure
programme.desc: In the heart of the Pacific, in New Caledonia, the Kanaks have been fighting for their independence for over 40 years, and they use nickel as a weapon to achieve their end. The subsoil of the island is filled with this ore essential for global growth. To finance their future state, the Kanaks open mines, build factories, to have a part on the materials market. Is this nation of 100,000 people at risk of losing far more precious by gambling with raw material and to shift from political dependence to a financial one?

programme.title: Crazy For Madonna
programme.desc: A biography of a universal icon of music and Hollywood, Madonna, better known as the Queen of Pop. Sabbatical Entertainment celebrates Madonna's illustrious career spanning more than four decades, always pushing the boundaries of entertainment. Not afraid of controversy, the Material girl, through her talents, redefined and reshaped pop culture history.

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: A breakdown of most every Batman character throughout cinematic and television history.

programme.title: Saving Auschwitz?
programme.desc: 70 years after Auschwitz Museum was founded as the memorial site of the Shoah, this site is subject to diversions, confrontations and plundering. Several attempts to exploit and rewrite its history are at work. The danger of desensitization through mass tourism, or the attempts of the local town and its citizens to simply erase the nightmare to make place for new urban landscape are real threats affecting the future of this memorial site. Today, as the last survivors are passing on, what to do with the Auschwitz site?

programme.title: Costa Rica: Wildlife under the Rainbow
programme.desc: The tropical climate and varied topography of the Costa Rica have fostered exceptional biodiversity, with wildlife from both North and South America. From the peaks of volcanoes down to the Pacific and Caribbean shores, let's discover the life of 90 of the most remarkable mammals, beautiful birds, and astonishing reptiles…

programme.title: A Dog's Life
programme.desc: A Dog's Life explores the widely assumed facts that may actually be based on faulty and out-dated research. Ingenious experiments and meticulous observation reveal that the problems dogs solve best are those that involve interacting with humans. A fascinating and fun documentary that gives us 'a dog's eye view' on the world.

programme.title: Oh, Dior!
programme.desc: Sabbatical Entertainment's exclusive original documentary admires Christian Dior, the famous French fashion designer whose post-World War II creations were wildly popular and whose legacy continues to influence the fashion industry.

programme.title: Assasination II
programme.desc: Assassination II, portrays the murder of Venustiano Carranza, Francisco Villa and Alvaro Obregon, occurred during the last years of the Mexican Revolution. Assassination II is a format that blends the past with the present; historical reconstruction, structured by the questions Who, how and why it will unveil each of the questions surrounding the details of each of the deaths of these important figures in Mexican history. Assassination II , portrays from its unknown side, the personality of the victims, the murderers, and also the personality of the intellectual murderers of each case. The program develops the leadership of historian Pedro Salmerón, in each case, and with a specialist historian that retrace the different lines of research that were taken just after the events, and secret plots hatched to that truth comes to light, while we'll find out the true events revealed after several years of research. With this format, viewers will witness the truths hitherto undisclosed Mexican history.

programme.title: Mongolia, Steppes Emirate
programme.desc: Battered by strong winds, and seen as a grazing land, Mongolia is the kingdom of steppes. With important mineral resources such as copper or uranium, coal and rare soil, Mongolia future is secure: the economy shows a significant growth rate and it is a business paradise for some expatriates. But for most of the population, needs remain unfulfilled.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Bonjour! We're headed to Quebec Province on today's show. First, we get blown away by the thunderous pipes at Montreal's Notre Dame Basilica. After that, we go underneath the city at the Pointe a Calliere archaeology museum. Next, we'll learn about the native ecosystem at the gigantic, indoor, BioDome. Lastly, we'll learn about the 1967 Montreal Expo at the structures that are still visited today.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This episode we visit the bright lights of Vancouver, Canada. We'll swing along the famous Capilano Suspension Bridge, get tranquil in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Chinese garden, learn about Captain Vancouver at the Vancouver Maritime Museum, dig up Cesna Em "The City Before the City" at the Museum of Vancouver, and dive into the city's seedy underbelly at the Police Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Chasing big Chinook Salmon just outside Rivers Inlet, BC from Duncanby Lodge!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Whether you refer to Udaipur as the City of Lakes or the City of Dawn, you are sure to agree that romance and beauty fill the air. While traveling by boat, we visit the many palaces and temples on the shore. We also tour the majestic City Palace and the Garden of the Maids of Honor. In Jaipur, we tour the Pink City, paying close attention to such architectural treasures as the Palace of Winds (Hawa Mahal) and the Amber Fort. We also visit the magnificent collections housed in the City Palace.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Caves have held a special place in human development. The Hindu, Buddhist and Jain caves in these two UNESCO sites contain some of the most beautiful carvings and paintings found in Asia. This episode explores the history and relationship between these religions.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Gold, ivory and slaves drove the economy of the East coast of Africa 500 years ago. Join us as we explore the Portuguese and Arab roles in these horrific trade schemes. We'll also investigate the pristine waters off the coast of the nearby National Park where our host dons a snorkel mask and comes face-to-face with the creatures of the coral reef.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Few people know that Gandhi got his political activist start in South Africa. This is a city where Asia meets Africa and is one of the most diverse cities in the world. Here Journeys encounters people of European, Far Eastern and Indian descent as well as the local Zulus.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: World Wave Sailing Champion's explore the beauty and mystique of Maui, as they prepare for the "Aloha Classic," the final stop on the World Wavesailing Tour.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Tanner Hall is today's most influential skier. He has won every contest, he knows every trick and there is seemingly nothing he cannot do. An idol for some, a nemesis for others, Hall is no stranger to controversy.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: Famous Chinese Erhu player Zhao Lei is leaving his stamp on classical Chinese music by experimenting with musical fusion between the East and West. On a sharper note in downtown Shanghai, Yuyintang Livehouse opens its doors to contemporary music lovers. The spiritual home of cutting edge beats in Shanghai, Yuyintang has started the careers of Visual Kei band Lilith and progressive metal rockers Mathlotus, but the modern music scene is still reeling from the Rock 'n' Roll ban of the Cultural Revolution. Join them as they strive to become the rock stars of tomorrow.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: On the 11th of November, 1918, the First World War drew to an end with a terrible toll… after a conflict unlike anything Humanity had ever seen before. For 4 years and 3 months, soldiers from at least 20 countries were plunged in the hell of trenches… caught under a deluge of bombs.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: International kayakers travel the whitewater of Norway and show us the natural beauty that Norway has to offer.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow base jumping icon and ski base pioneer into the heart of Switzerland.

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Kertis traga za inspiracijom u vinogradima, selima i obalama u jugozapadnom delu Australije. Upoznaje vlasnika ranča koji uzgaja kratkoroga goveda koja idu na ispašu. Kertis peca slatkovodne rakove.

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Kertis putuje u Lombardiju kako bi otkrio lokalni sir i seljačko jelo. Kreće na helikoptersko razgledanje vinograda Franćijakorta, da pokupi penušavo vino koje će upariti sa kavijarom koji se proizvodi u regiji.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: Džejmi prikazuje čitav niz jela koja se prave u jednom tiganju. Prvo na redu je losos u kesici, zatim jednostavni uštipci iz tiganja, pečeni rolat od svinjetine i rižoto koji se pripremaju u istoj tepsiji za musaku.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Džejmi unapređuje pripremu obroka za radnu nedelju. Prvo pravi jednostavne i ukusne njoke, zatim ogromne, ljutkaste ćufte na brzi način i za kraj, okreće omiljeno porodično jelo naglavačke. U pitanju je prevrnuta riblja pita.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci
programme.desc: Donal Skijan će podeliti još pet svakodnevnih jela koja su sačinjena od najzdravijih sastojaka. Ove nedelje na meniju su hrskavi svinjski batačići sa komoračem pečeni na tiganju. Zatim slede kari od patlidžana sa pirinčem i karfiol sa kurkumom.

programme.title: Donalovi brzi superobroci
programme.desc: Pet ukusnih jela prikazano je u svakoj epizodi serijala "Donalovi brzi superobroci". Sve se vrti oko prave hrane koja se brzo priprema, a usput je i zdrava. Donal Skijan će podeliti pet novih recepata za ovu nedelju. Na meniju je pečena piletina.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: Adam i Po odlaze u regiju Gipsland u Australiji, da bi otkrili ljubav prema jednostavnoj domaćoj hrani i pokušali da pripreme najbolji australijski porodični obrok.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: U svakom regionalnom gradiću u Australiji, moguće je naći tri ključna dela australijske kulture i kuhinje, a to su: bar, pekara i restoran kineske hrane.

programme.title: Prelepa peciva sa Džulijet Sir
programme.desc: Džulijet se raduje zdravom početku godine, pa priprema slane mafine, proteinske štanglice od granole i neverovatnu biljnu tortu po imenu "Cacti & Succulents". Dr Randž priprema zdrave i ukusne lazanje od 5 vrsta povrća.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Ova epizoda je posvećena domaćoj hrani, onoj koju bi spremila baka na selu. Predjelo čine sir i sveže šargarepe. Domaća banica (gibanica) punjena je spanaćem i kozjim sirom. Lora i Stojan ručno će razviti testo.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Lora i Stojan istražuju one posebne trenutke, kada spremamo nešto izvanredno za goste. Slani mafini su jednostavni i mogu se servirati u svim prilikama. Za glavno jelo predlaže se riba u sosu od šafrana i kuskusu ili mesni rolat.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Lora i Stojan prikazaće tri zanimljiva jela. Čorba od paradajza sa kuvanim jajima od sastojaka dostupnih u svakom domaćinstvu. Umak od sira i artičoka, lagan i ukusan prilog jelima, i testenina sa piletinom i sirom.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Jela koja će Lora i Stojan spremiti u ovoj epizodi donose prelep ukus Mediterana. Za čorbu je potrebna konzerva leblebija, malo povrća i začini. Naredno jelo je za sve one koji vole goveđu džigericu sa gljivama i kobasicom ćorizo.

programme.title: Luk Nuen: Vijetnam
programme.desc: Luk obilazi sela u okolini Sape, istražuje bogate lokalne tradicije i priprema jelo sa lokalnom kuvaricom Su Mej, u njenom selu Ta Phin. Ovde zajedno pripremaju poljske pečurke, koje su ubrane istog jutra. Kasnije, Luk pravi svinjske ražnjiće.

programme.title: Luk Nuen: Vijetnam
programme.desc: Malo selo po imenu Bak Ha oživljava vikendom jer mnogi turisti dolaze zbog poznate pijace. Luk priprema piletinu sa đumbirom dok ga mnogi gosti uzbuđeno posmatraju. Luk napušta pijacu i saznaje kako se prave ljubičaste nudle i dimljena patka.

programme.title: Rik Stajn: Mediteranski izleti
programme.desc: U Maroku, Rik uživa u kuskusu i isprobava tažine i čajeve od nane, koje pronalazi na bazarima. Rik sprema marokansko jelo kefta mkaouara (jednostavno jelo od luka, paradajza, kima i paprike, pečeno sa ljutkastim ćuftama i jajima).

programme.desc: Džimi saznaje zašto su konji rase klajdsdejl i dalje poželjniji od traktora. Kasnije odlazi do jezera Elsmir u koje se ulivaju reke i iz kojeg Maori love jegulje koje dime i kasnije prodaju svuda po Novom Zelandu.

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši
programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Kako možete da napravite hleb koji se ne mesi, sa mnogo semenki? Glavno jelo je više nego impresivno, pileći bataci sa kiselim kupusom. Meni se završava musom od mleka i čokolade sa mirisnim dunjama i prelivom.

programme.title: Nadia Husein: Kuvaj jednom, jedi dvaput

programme.title: Brzina metka
programme.desc: Petoro plaćenih ubica u brzom vozu otkrivaju da su im misije međusobno povezane.

programme.title: Na sprovodu
programme.desc: Kad sve krene naopako za neobičnu Karis Rajtman, ona radi ono što bi učinila svaka emotivno izolovana, moderna devojka _ počinje da posećuje sahrane nepoznatih ljudi. Na jednoj sudbonosnoj sahrani upoznaje Tajlera, čoveka kome je umrla verenica. Uprkos upozorenjima grobara Šejna, njenog najboljeg prijatelja, kao i cimerke Lile, prvi put uspeva da ostvari nekakvu vezu. Tragajući za odgovorima, Karis odlazi kod svoje otuđene majke kako bi se suočila s prošlošću.

programme.title: Ubistvo predsednika srednje škole
programme.desc: U katoličkoj srednjoj školi, popularna devojka udružuje se s novinarkom iz drugog razreda kako bi istražile slučaj ukradenih SAT ispita. Kada dvojac usmeri sumnje prema osumnjičenima, otkriva se mnogo veća zavera.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Deca špijuni: Sve vreme sveta
programme.desc: Novopečena penzionisana agentkinja Džesika Vilson pokušava da se prilagodi porodičnom životu, ali su joj kućni poslovi teži od bilo kakve misije. Kada porodična amajlija slučajno oslobodi opasnog Čuvara Vremena, Džesika se vraća u akciju, a deca Sesil i Rebeka, uz pomoć starih Špijunčića, postaju jedina nada za spas porodice i čitavog sveta.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Riba velika kao kanu
programme.desc: Odmor Bila Kolinsa jednog po podneva u Šugar Kriku pretvara se u mnogo više od toga kada Poetri nabasa na nekog sakrivenog u močvari.

programme.title: Družina iz Šugar krika: Oživljavanje zločinaca
programme.desc: Dugo očekivani praznik Preobraženja u Šugar Kriku konačno je tu, ali jutro počinje veoma loše za neke od stanovnika. Družina očekuje večernje slavlje, a vreme prekraćuju kupanjem u potoku, sve dok se ne pojave siledžije. Nakon koškanja u potoku, Big Bob Til govori članovima družine da je slavlje u velikoj opasnosti. Odmah po dolasku, kreće potraga za dokazima.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Tajno sklonište
programme.desc: Četvrti nastavak iz serijala "Družina iz Šugar Krika". Družina juri kroz močvaru, ali nailaze na prethodno neistraženu teritoriju, koja ih vodi usred misterije. Kao da to nije dosta, Poetrino jagnje izaziva haos u školi, pa su zbog njega svi u nevolji kod gđice Lili. Kad se sve smiri, družina planira da noć provede u pećini nadomak groblja, ali Tom Til otkriva tajnu koja će ih sve uzdrmati.

programme.title: Projekat Dinosaur
programme.desc: Projekat "Dinosaurus" govori o ekspediciji oca i sina u Kongu, uz pratnju dokumentarističke TV ekipe. Kada svi akteri filma misteriozno nestanu, pronađeni snimak pokazaće zapanjujuće prizore dinosaurusa, za koje se verovalo da su izumrli pre 65 miliona godina.

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Obućar
programme.desc: "Kobler" govori o obućaru, četvrtoj generaciji u porodičnom poslu, koji pronalazi magičnu šivaću mašinu u podrumu svog oca. Mašina mu omogućava da živi živote svih ljudi koji nose njegove cipele.

programme.title: Nas dvojica
programme.desc: Žan Hristian Ranu (Daniel Auteuil) je malo ekscentričan knjigovođa koji živi dan za danom. Žil Gabriel (Alain Chabat) je pop pevač koji je već imao svojih pet minuta slave. Niko ne bi ni pomislio da živote ta dva potpuno različita muškarca mogu da se povežu. Pop zvezda se sprema za svoj veliki povratak na scenu. Ipak, njegovi planovi se remete kada ga Ranu udari kolima. Kad Ranu dolazi sebi, otkriva da u glavi ima neki drugi glas. Uspostavlja se da je Gabrijel preminuo i nekako ušao u telo knjigovođe. Od tog trenutka, Ranu postaje dve osobe u jednom telu…

programme.title: Operacija "Morski vuk"
programme.desc: U poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, Nemačka, očajna i u potrazi za poslednjom šansom da porazi saveznike, okuplja svoje preostale podmornice za završnu misiju: napad na kontinentalne Sjedinjene Države.

programme.title: Praktične devojke
programme.desc: Dve bogate sestre, naslednice porodičnog kozmetičkog carstva, suočavaju se sa surovom realnošću kada ih skandal i istraga ostave bez nasledstva.

programme.title: Mali diktator
programme.desc: Lenji diplomirani pravnik usvaja dete kako bi zadivio devojku, ali ništa ne ide po planu. Sada mora da odraste i nauči kako da se nosi sa izazovima očinstva.

programme.title: Dnevnik opijanja
programme.desc: Krajem pedesetih godina prošlog veka, neuspeli pisac postaje radnik propalog časopisa u Portoriku, gde upada u kandže alkohola, postaje deo sumnjive šeme za eksploataciju zemljišta i zaljubljuje se u prelepu, ali verenu ženu.

programme.title: Izabrana porodica
programme.desc: En je instruktorka joge koja se trudi da postigne unutrašnji mir, uprkos tome što je njena porodica izluđuje, a ljubavni život joj je katastrofalan. Ne zna kako da kaže "ne" i želi da rešava tuđe probleme. U međuvremenu, pokušava da spase svoju sestru Klio od zavisnosti, što dovodi do katastrofalnih posledica. Pod pritiskom brojnih očekivanja, oslanja se na svoje dobre prijatelje Maksa, Frensis, Roz i Elu za podršku. Oni joj zauzvrat nameštaju simpatičnog razvedenog oca Stiva, koji ima preslatku sedmogodišnju ćerku. Kada upozna Stivovu ćerku Lili, En je odmah očarana, ali Lili ne oseća isto; što su Stiv i En bliži, to Lili postaje ljubomornija. Kad Lili počne loše da se ponaša, En shvata da u Stivovim očima ona ne može da pogreši, pa započinje bitku života sa sedmogodišnjakinjom.
